title: One Prompt, Full Stack Export
hook: Signhify exports a ZIP containing frontend and an Express API starter.

scenes.narration: Signhify can export a complete project as a ZIP file.
scenes.headline: ZIP Export

scenes.narration: The frontend includes all HTML, CSS, and JavaScript ready to serve.
scenes.headline: Ready HTML, CSS, JS

scenes.narration: It also bundles an Express API starter for backend logic.
scenes.headline: Express API starter

scenes.narration: One prompt generates a scroll-reactive site and a deployable ZIP with both layers.
scenes.headline: Full stack export

scenes.narration: Unzip, npm install, then npm start to run the full stack locally.
scenes.headline: Run locally

scenes.narration: Deploy the ZIP to any host, and the site runs with native scroll parallax instantly.
scenes.headline: Deploy in minutes
